inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.constructor.db
inputs.description: The caller-supplied synchronous SQLite database used by the adapter for prepared statements and exec calls. Importing or constructing the adapter does not open a database.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.constructor.models
inputs.description: The readonly list of SQLite models registered during construction. Each model is passed to sqliteTableSql, and duplicate table names throw an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.find.table
inputs.description: The registered model table name used for this lookup. A table without a registered model throws an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.find.id
inputs.description: The numeric or string record key passed to the table adapter for this lookup. SqliteAdapter does not coerce or generate the key.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.findBy.table
inputs.description: The registered model table name used for this query. A table without a registered model throws an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.findBy.fields
inputs.description: The property/value filters forwarded to the table adapter for this query. SqliteAdapter itself does not interpret these values.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.create.table
inputs.description: The registered model table name used for insertion. A table without a registered model throws an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.create.input
inputs.description: The property/value record forwarded to insert for creation. SqliteAdapter does not reshape the object before calling insert.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update.table
inputs.description: The registered model table name used for this update. A table without a registered model throws an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update.id
inputs.description: The numeric or string record key passed to the table adapter for this update. SqliteAdapter does not coerce or generate the key.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update.input
inputs.description: The property/value record forwarded to the table adapter for updating this row. SqliteAdapter passes the object through unchanged.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.delete.table
inputs.description: The registered model table name used for deletion. A table without a registered model throws an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.delete.id
inputs.description: The numeric or string record key passed to the table adapter for deletion. SqliteAdapter does not coerce or generate the key.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.insert.table
inputs.description: The registered model table name used for synchronous insertion. A table without a registered model throws an Error.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.insert.input
inputs.description: The property/value record forwarded to the table adapter for insertion. SqliteAdapter passes the object through unchanged.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.query.sql
inputs.description: The SQL statement prepared by the injected database and read with its all method. SqliteAdapter passes the statement unchanged.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.query.bindings
inputs.description: The SQLite values spread into the prepared statement's all call. This input defaults to an empty array and accepts only SqliteValue members.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.execute.sql
inputs.description: The SQL statement prepared by the injected database and executed with its run method. SqliteAdapter passes the statement unchanged.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.execute.bindings
inputs.description: The SQLite values spread into the prepared statement's run call. This input defaults to an empty array and accepts only SqliteValue members.

inputs.name: SqliteAdapter.transaction.write
inputs.description: The callback invoked between a savepoint and its release. It must be synchronous and return no thenable, or transaction throws an Error.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.db
inputs.description: The caller-supplied synchronous SQLite database used by the adapter for prepared statements and exec calls. The factory does not open a database.

inputs.name: createSqliteAdapter.models
inputs.description: The readonly list of SQLite models passed to the new adapter. Duplicate table names throw an Error during construction.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.find
outputs.description: The promise resolves to the row found for the supplied id, or null when no row matches. The row shape is determined by the caller's T.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.findBy
outputs.description: The promise resolves to all rows matching the supplied fields and may contain no rows. Each row has the caller's T shape.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.create
outputs.description: The promise resolves to the row returned by insert for the supplied input. Its shape is determined by the caller's T.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.update
outputs.description: The promise resolves to the updated row, or null when no row matches the supplied id. The row shape is determined by the caller's T.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.delete
outputs.description: The promise resolves to true when the table adapter deletes a row and false when it deletes none. It does not return the deleted row.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.insert
outputs.description: The synchronous result is the inserted row returned by the table adapter. Its shape is determined by the caller's T.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.query
outputs.description: The result is the array returned by the prepared statement's all method. It may be empty, and each row has the caller's T shape.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.execute
outputs.description: The result is returned by the prepared statement's run method and is typed unknown in this contract. The SQLite statement interface defines changes and lastInsertRowid on that result.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.createTables
outputs.description: The method passes generated CREATE TABLE SQL to db.exec for every registered model. It returns no value.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.transaction
outputs.description: The result is the value returned by the synchronous callback after the savepoint is released. If the callback or a database operation throws, the method rolls back to the savepoint and rethrows.

outputs.name: SqliteAdapter.assertModels
outputs.description: The method checks that every non-SQLite application table has a model and that each model's declared columns match the actual table columns. It returns no value and throws an Error on either mismatch.

outputs.name: createSqliteAdapter
outputs.description: The factory creates and returns a SqliteAdapter using the supplied database and models. Duplicate model table names cause construction to throw an Error.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown for duplicate model table names, requests for unregistered tables, asynchronous or thenable transaction callbacks, and model/schema mismatches detected by assertModels.
